aws-cli-and-mcp-profile-for-data-warehou.summary: In data-warehouse-scripts, always use the AWS profile reporting, for both the AWS CLI and the AWS MCP.

check-knowledge-before-implementing.summary: Before changing code in documented areas (pools, RemUnits, pool restart, event ordering, conventions), read the relevant knowledge entries first.

code-verification.summary: Verify code changes by building, add unit tests for core logic changes, and run the existing tests.

commingling-pool-replication-sequence-cf.summary: A change to a commingled pool is replicated from the host tote to guest totes: the host CFS collects it, stores it in S3 and publishes it globally, and each guest CFS recreates competitors, sport events and the pool.

debug-sequence-mvp-market-metrics-never-.summary: MVP market_metrics stay at their inserted values because the update path (SetResults) is never called, not because 0 is written.

debugging-workflow.summary: When debugging, verify theories and propose fixes, but don't change code until the user confirms.

do-not-reload-pool-on-each-message-ticke.summary: Don't reload the pool from the DB on each sport event history message: GetPoolAsync doesn't load TicketList, so units stay 0; use the pool given at start.

engine-pool-controllers-restart-flow.summary: A pool controller restart runs Console → ReloadTicketsForPool → cycle data → POOL_AMENDMENT on the messages topic → the engine restarts the pool's controllers.

event-flow-architecture.summary: Sport event status changes flow from the console through the database and Kafka to the engine (enginelinux).

gitlab-conventions.summary: Colossus GitLab is the self-hosted gitlab.colossusbets.com, not GitLab.com; point glab at that host.

pool-event-flow-strategy-split-match-vs-.summary: Match pools (type_code with is_match_kind = 1) use MarketBasedPoolEventFlowStrategy; all other pools use SportEventBasedPoolEventFlowStrategy.

pool-start-sequence-cycle-data-daemon.summary: Cycle data finalises a pool (cycledata_finalised) and the pools Kafka topic makes the engine start it; a controller restart is a separate flow via POOL_AMENDMENT.

premature-exit-replay-vs-db-and-vacuous-.summary: The controller exited early because replay marked legs official in memory (LegOfficial) while the DB still had them unofficial, not because a pool had no legs.

reload-tickets-flag-cleared-by-engine.summary: The console sets reload_tickets when it requests a pool controller restart; the engine clears it after handling the resulting POOL_AMENDMENT.

ru-history-skip-rules-in-one-place.summary: All rules for skipping a remaining-unit history row live in one method, ShouldSkipRemUnitHistoryRow; amendments are never skipped.

sep-markets-fantasy-and-mvp-evolution.summary: SEP pools link legs to metrics through markets rather than event results; Fantasy extends SEP with player metrics across events, and MVP extends Fantasy.

statsfeeddaemon-stats-and-cbtote-updates.summary: StatsFeedDaemon downloads SportsData stats into stats_feed and writes metrics to cbtote only for markets used in pools.

team-image-s3-key-bb-and-normal-pools.summary: Team images are stored at the S3 key {Sport}/{Season}/{Sport}_{GlobalTeamId}.{EXT}, e.g. FOOTBALL/2026/FOOTBALL_90002051.PNG.
